mapper.select: SELECT * FROM proj_result_subscription WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND project_id=#{query.projectId} AND id=#{query.id} AND deleted=0 FOR UPDATE

mapper.update: UPDATE proj_result_subscription SET phase=#{query.phase},inventory_cursor=#{query.inventoryCursor}, processed_sequence=#{query.processedSequence},through_sequence=#{query.throughSequence},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND project_id=#{query.projectId} AND id=#{query.id} AND version=#{query.expectedVersion} AND phase != 'RETIRED' AND deleted=0
